entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hello, Diana. I'm calling about an order I received last week. I'd like to start a return for a helmet I purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. Just to make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference issue?

It's a preference thing. The color just isn't what I expected from the pictures online. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out. I want to exchange it for a different one because having the right gear is important for my safety and visibility.
I completely understand. Wanting the right color for your gear makes perfect sense. Let me just pull up your order. Can I get your order number, please?
Thank you... Okay, I see the order right here. You received the helmet 8 days ago. That's perfectly within our 10-day return window for standard items.
Oh, 10 days? That's great. So I can send it back?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. You should see it in the next few minutes. Just print it, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it at any post office for a full refund.

That's fantastic, thank you Diana. I appreciate how easy that was. Since I do have to go through the trouble of re-boxing it and making a trip to the post office, is there any chance you could provide a small discount code for my next purchase? I'm planning to order the correct helmet right away.

I understand you're asking for a discount for the inconvenience. While I'm not able to offer a promotional code for a return based on preference, I can assure you the return shipping is completely free, and you will get a 100% refund of your original purchase price once the item is received at our warehouse.
I see. Not even a small 5% for a loyal customer? It would just make reordering a little smoother.

I really do appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit, and I'm glad we could get this return sorted out for you so easily. However, my system simply doesn't have an option to generate goodwill credits for this type of return. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's alright. The free return label is the most important part. I'll look for that email. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome. The email has been sent. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
